description.zh: 要替换授权用户的共享型云电脑ID。
description.en: The ID of the cloud computer share.

description.zh: 需添加的授权用户ID列表。可配置1~500个。
description.en: The IDs of the end users that you want to add. You can configure 1 to 500 IDs.

description.zh: 需移除的授权用户ID列表。可配置1~500个。
description.en: The IDs of the end users that you want to remove. You can configure 1 to 500 IDs.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 为共享型云电脑替换授权用户
